title: Spiced Quesadilla with Lovely Peas
description: A unique twist on traditional quesadillas, this Indian-inspired dish combines the earthy flavors of lovely peas with the richness of cheese.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of vegan butter or oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the lovely peas and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the earth spices and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Place a quesadilla in the skillet and sprinkle with cheese and lovely peas.
Fold the quesadilla in half and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the cheese is melted and the tortilla is crispy.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the other side is also crispy.
Repeat with the remaining quesadillas and filling ingredients.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and garnish with chopped cilantro.
